mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 3-month moving average signals an easing monetary policy stance, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below its 3-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < prior month AND RSAFS < prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdown periods (INDPRO declines from prior month), reduced industrial output dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds prior quarter, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 5.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, triggering expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) from prior month signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < prior month AND UNRATE > prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises from prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high-inflation, high-rate regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0% AND FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), aggressive monetary tightening weighs on equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 4.0% and FEDFUNDS is above 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
